elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor provides transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 applies upon expiration or termination for any reason, and subsection (a) requires Commerce One to provide reasonable transition assistance at Corio's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: Subsection (a) expressly provides for a period of up to six months.

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Subsection (a) expressly states that assistance is provided at Commerce One's then-current rates.

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Subsection (b) requires Commerce One to return to Corio all data of Corio and its Customers in Commerce One's possession or control.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The 30-day period runs from Corio's written request, not from expiry or termination. If Corio does not make an immediate request, return need not occur within 30 days after exit.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Subsection (b) requires return in a commonly used, machine-readable format, which satisfies the standard machine-readable-format requirement.

elements.element: After return, Vendor deletes the returned Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) requires deletion thereafter but permits retention to perform any surviving obligation or as required by law. The preferred position does not include these exceptions, and the surviving-obligations exception may allow continued retention.

elements.element: After deletion, Vendor certifies the deletion.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) expressly requires Commerce One to certify the deletion to Corio in writing, although the certification follows the qualified deletion obligation.

elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor provides transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 applies upon expiration or termination for any reason and requires Commerce One to provide reasonable transition assistance at Corio's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: The right to transition assistance for up to six months encompasses the fallback period of 90 days.

elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor exports Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Subsection (b) requires Commerce One to return all Corio and Customer data in a commonly used, machine-readable format, which substantively provides a data export right.

elements.element: Customer Data is exported within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause measures the 30-day deadline from Corio's written request rather than from expiry or termination, and imposes no export deadline if no request is made.

result.reason: The redline is targeted and professionally drafted, and it preserves the existing survival and support provisions. It nevertheless fails both positions because the data-return deadline is triggered by a later written request rather than by expiry or termination. The preferred position also is not fully met because deletion is subject to retention exceptions not stated in that position. Because the redline does not reach either complete level, it is not minimal as defined.
